title: "No human at the helm": Delaware plan would let AI agents run entire businesses
summary: Owners of AI-run firms would evade liability for "reckless" AI, US Rep. Comer says.
llm_summary: A new Delaware proposal would let autonomous AI agents act as the legal “heads” of corporations, allowing the companies to operate without any human officers. Critics, including U.S. Rep. Andy Comer, warn that the bill would let owners dodge responsibility for reckless
